title: Member cards count the owner's own taps, and a card the owner has set opens its link for them too
detail: Owner report 2026-10-22, after LIVE-1282 shipped: his card opened his Spotlight but "it didn't log my last bump", and My card said "Checks in at every Space" on a card that no longer checks in anywhere. Three changes. /c/<token> now logs the owner's own tap as an 'open'; it still pays no Zaps and files no contact. The owner goes to /crew/card only while the card is on its default (page mode); once they have set a link or the virtual card, their own tap goes there like anyone's, so they can test it. The My card list calls a Frequency-wide card "Your Frequency card", and the editor says Zaps come when a member taps your card, not on every tap. Follows LIVE-1282 and ADR-1874; no migration.
